data.title: Why Is XRP Still Down 17% for 2026 When Bitcoin and Solana Are Almost Even?
data.description: Bitcoin and Solana have nearly clawed back everything they lost in 2026, yet XRP keeps getting left behind despite outpacing both coins during the recent rally. The reason comes down to a mathematical trap that punishes coins with steeper drops far more than most traders realize.
data.author: Sam Daodu
